name: Sinosteel New Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Sinosteel New Materials Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacturing, and sale of magnetic materials, metal products, and mining equipment in China and internationally. The company offers magnetic tiles, including ferrite, manganese trioxide, neodymium iron boron, and iron powder core for automotive, household appliance, and DC motors; and elastic material; and equipment manufacturing products comprising high pressure roller mill, magnetic separation equipment, tower grinder, filtration equipment, roller crusher, and experimental study.
